name: Sunrise
dining_districts: the Amerant Bank Arena events corridor
the Sunrise Boulevard and University Drive plazas
intro: Sunrise runs on event volume. Sawgrass Mills pulls more visitors than almost any attraction in Florida, its dining ring turns tables all day, and the Amerant Bank Arena — home ice for the Panthers — dumps thousands of hungry people into the same corridor on game nights. Around it all sits one of Broward's biggest corporate parks, with lunch kitchens and caterers working banker's hours.

Kitchens here need a supplier that can flex hard: standing orders sized for ordinary Tuesdays, step-ups for playoff runs, concert nights, and holiday shopping weekends. Our midnight cutoff and 7-day routes make those swings manageable — order tonight for tomorrow's crowd. The run from Pompano Beach takes about twenty-five minutes on the Sawgrass Expressway.
route_note: About 25 minutes west of our Pompano Beach warehouse via the Sawgrass Expressway — Mills-area and arena-corridor stops run daily, with event-week step-ups.

faqs_unique.q: Can Sunrise kitchens scale orders for arena events and mall peak season?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Hold a baseline standing order and step volume up by the midnight cutoff for game nights, concerts, and holiday weekends — routes run seven days, so peak Saturdays are covered.

faqs_unique.q: Do you deliver to restaurants in the Sawgrass Mills area?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. The Mills dining ring and surrounding plazas are daily stops, with delivery timed to each property's dock and your receiving window.

cta_text: Tell us your Sawgrass-area traffic patterns, event volume, group dining needs, or everyday restaurant staples, and we will help set a produce order that fits your service rhythm.
